subject: Yes: include the cards.generated.json line in pack_totals.py with your immune batch
body: Agreed, good catch: phase 2c landed after I wrote pack_totals.py. The fix also covers tests/db/test_seed.py, whose pack_flashcards expectation uses PACKS.cards, as long as the importer loads generated cards into pack_flashcards too. Please run tests/db/test_seed.py -m db on a local stack once. I'll regenerate renal-endo-nutrition/cards.generated.json in my next integrate.
